items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I used to go up on the Winter Garden. He was Joe Oliver. Joe Oliver played up there.

ctx.x: I've seen sometimes they do that and sometimes they don't. Yeah, we put piano on the truck. They were waiting for them all on the truck, on the corners. Crowds would be waiting for them to pass and they'd have regular street dances and dance to their music. How would you sit on the truck, by the way? We had chairs. But I mean, who'd be in the front of the truck and who'd be in the back?

Well, most of the time the piano and the drummer would be in the back, you see? And the cornet and the trombone would be right at the tail of the truck. In other words, the piano would be in the front, Joe. In the front, yeah.

Right in the back. Back behind you, huh? Yeah. And who would be between the piano and the clarinet and guitar? When did banjos get popular here? Ask Harry, you used to play that. Ask Harry, you used to have banjo play on. You're the first one over here? Or they have them before you? Or, Herbert, what's that boy named Herbert, who? Used to play with the Go Get Them Band. I got him. Yeah, that's when you went to the Go Get Them Band, after him. Yeah. I started after Herbert. You remember that Goldman, the kid in…
